basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A trade shipment groups goods sold; a transport consignment groups goods moved under one carriage contract.
Custody, ownership and transport status are separate assertions.
Packages and handling units are bound, not owned, here.
Milestones are assertions from sources, not proof of delivery.

may: Register shipments and consignments and allocate items.
Record milestones with source and time.
mustNot: Accept custody or confirm delivery without evidence.

considerations: Misdeclared dangerous goods endanger workers and the public.
Shipment data identifies consignees and their addresses.
Forced-labour and sanctions checks protect people in supply chains.

items: Gross mass in kilograms, including packaging.
Package count as a whole number.
Temperature in degrees Celsius for controlled goods, measured during carriage.
A consignment has a consignor, consignee, transport document number, package count and gross weight.
Often confused with an order, a handling unit and an inventory movement.
